newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT-GENICOM in talks to buy DEC unit.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-GENICOM in talks to buy DEC unit.

text.p: GENICOM Corp said Wednesday it is in discussions regarding a possible transaction with Digital involving Digital's printing systems business. No agreement has been reached.
A full text of the company's press release follows.

GENICOM Corp (Nasdaq: GECM) disclosed today that it is involved in discussions with Digital Equipment Corporation concerning a possible transaction involving Digital's Printing Systems Business. No agreement has been reached, and there can be no assurance that agreement will be reached. The parties do not intend to make further announcements unless and until an agreement is reached.

GENICOM Corporation is an international supplier of network integration, multivendor services and printer solutions. The Enterprising Service Solutions company (ESSC) provides integrated network solutions which include network integration, professional services and help desk support, in addition to logo and multivendor on-site and off-site product repair and express parts. The Document Solutions company (DSC) designs and markets a wide range of computer printer technologies for general purpose applications. GENICOM is headquartered within metropolitan Washington, D.C.
